blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Weekends in London are full of small, lovely plans. People go to markets, they walk in the parks, and on Sunday they eat a Sunday roast.

Today we use "going to" to talk about these plans. It is the easiest way to sound confident about the future. For example: "I'm going to visit Borough Market" or "We're going to walk along the Thames."

London weekends are short, so it is good to plan well. When you say "I'm going to...", you talk about a plan for the future, not a decision you make right now.

items.q: What do people often eat in London on Sunday?
items.why: "on Sunday they eat a Sunday roast."

items.q: Why do we use "going to" in this lesson?
options: To talk about plans for the future
items.why: "we use 'going to' to talk about these plans" — planos futuros.

items.q: The text says London weekends are…
items.why: "London weekends are short, so it is good to plan well."

items.q: The text suggests that "going to" is…
options: an easy and confident way to talk about the future
items.why: Inferência: "the easiest way to sound confident about the future."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: markets are closed on the weekend
you should not plan your weekend in London
planning helps because the weekend is short
items.why: Inferência: "weekends are short, so it is good to plan well."

blocks.instruction: Ouça o visitante falar sobre seu primeiro fim de semana em Londres. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! This is my first weekend in London and I am very happy. I have a lot of plans.

On Saturday morning, I'm going to visit a big market near the river. My colleague says the food there is very good. After that, we're going to walk along the Thames and take some photos. I love to walk, so this is perfect for me.

In the afternoon, I'm going to a museum. The museums in London are free, and that is great news for a tourist like me!

On Sunday, my friend Sophie is going to cook a Sunday roast. James is going to watch the football on TV. I am not a big football fan, so I'm going to read a book in the park.

London weekends are short, so I plan well. What are you going to do this weekend?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the speaker going to do on Saturday morning?
options: Visit a market near the river
items.why: "On Saturday morning, I'm going to visit a big market near the river."

items.q: What are they going to do after the market?
options: Walk along the Thames and take photos
items.why: "we're going to walk along the Thames and take some photos."

items.q: Why is the speaker happy that London museums are free?
options: Because they are only open on Sunday
Because a tourist can save money
items.why: Inferência: "free" é uma boa notícia para o turista — ele economiza dinheiro.

items.q: What does the speaker feel about football?
options: He wants to watch it on TV
items.why: Inferência: "I am not a big football fan, so I'm going to read a book" — ele prefere outra coisa.

items.q: How does the speaker feel about his weekend?
items.why: Inferência: "I am very happy. I have a lot of plans."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I have a plan for Saturday." A plan is…
options: an idea about what you are going to do
items.why: Plan = plano: o que você pretende fazer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let's read a book in the ___ under a tree."
items.why: Park = parque: lugar verde com árvores.

items.q: "We're going to visit the market." To visit means to…
items.why: Visit = visitar, ir a um lugar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a lot of old art in that ___."
items.why: Museum = museu: lugar com arte e história.

items.q: "I am a tourist in London." A tourist is…
options: a person who visits a place on holiday
a person who lives and works there for many years
items.why: Tourist = turista: quem visita um lugar a passeio.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos para falar de planos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "What are you going to do this weekend?" This question asks about…
items.why: "going to do" pergunta sobre planos futuros.

items.q: "Let's go for a walk along the river." This means…
items.why: Go for a walk = dar uma caminhada, por prazer.

items.q: "I'm going to take some photos at the market." This means…
options: to make pictures with a camera or phone
items.why: Take photos = tirar fotos.

items.q: "Sophie is going to cook dinner on Sunday." This means she is going to…
items.why: Cook dinner = preparar o jantar.

items.q: "Come on, let's have a look at the museum." This means…
options: to look at or explore it
items.why: Have a look = dar uma olhada, ver algo.
